findings.location: §5가 '말을 옮기고 그 말을 확인하기' — 새 예 asks only one report and one -는다면서 question
findings.problem: GRAMMAR_ALLOCATION row 207 (-는다니2, productive_target: confirm the meaning of reported content) appears only in the supplied teaching example. The new Minho task produces reported -는대 and heard-information -는다면서, and later -다니 surprise belongs to distinct row 209. None asks the learner to produce row 207's checking function.
findings.proposal: After the two Minho sentences add: KO '민호에게 들은 내용의 뜻을 다시 확인하는 질문도 하나 써요. 놀라움을 강조하기보다 -는다니 계열로 가능 시각을 구체적으로 물어요. 예: 토요일 오후에 만날 수 있다니, 오후 몇 시부터 가능하다는 말인가요?' EN 'Add a question checking what Minho means by the reported availability. Use the -는다니 pattern to clarify the time, rather than expressing surprise: So you can meet Saturday afternoon—what time in the afternoon do you mean?' DE 'Ergänze eine Rückfrage zum gemeinten Zeitrahmen. Nutze das Muster -는다니 zur Klärung, nicht als Überraschung: Du kannst dich also Samstagnachmittag treffen—ab welcher Uhrzeit genau?' Keep the example hidden until the learner attempts it.

findings.location: §8 transfer model — '준에게 두 시 반부터 기다리신다고 들었어요.'
findings.problem: Jun's supplied message says Hyuna comes at 14:30; 'waiting from 14:30' comes from Hyuna's original message. The model changes Jun's actual report while this unit is teaching exact source/action separation. It can conceal rather than repair the relay distortion.
findings.proposal: Replace the four-sentence model with KO '준에게 두 시 반에 오신다고 들었는데, 원래 메시지에는 두 시 반부터 기다리겠다고 쓰셨네요. 공연은 세 시에 시작하는 거죠? 제가 어제 가 보니 입구가 두 개더군요. 어느 입구에서 만날까요?' EN 'Jun told me you were coming at two thirty, but your original message says you will wait from two thirty. The show starts at three, right? I visited yesterday and noticed two entrances. Which entrance shall we meet at?' DE 'Jun sagte mir, du kommst um halb drei; in deiner ursprünglichen Nachricht steht aber, dass du ab halb drei wartest. Die Vorstellung beginnt um drei, richtig? Gestern habe ich dort zwei Eingänge gesehen. An welchem treffen wir uns?' Preserve the source/observation/question rubric.

findings.location: §5나 camera new example — '친구가 ... 당신에게 빌린 카메라' followed by '돌려줄게'
findings.problem: The friend is the borrower, but the unlabelled first-person model can be read as the learner promising to return their own camera. The intended role change is easy to make explicit.
findings.proposal: Add to the prompt KO '카메라를 빌린 친구의 역할로 소유자인 당신에게 말하는 한 문장을 써요.' EN 'Write in the borrowing friend's role, addressing you as the owner.' DE 'Schreibe aus der Rolle der ausleihenden Person an dich als Eigentümer oder Eigentümerin.' Then the existing first-person model is consistent.
